verdict.rationale: Algolia documents an official CLI for working with its APIs from the terminal, explicitly aimed at interactive commands, scripts, and CI workflows. It includes browser-based authentication and app-management commands such as `algolia application list/select`. For the AI-native angle, the official `algolia-cli` agent skill lets agents manage indices, settings, rules, and synonyms through the CLI. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, and documentation of a full command reference, machine-readable output, or non-interactive (headless) auth for agent use.
